== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early Used Pile protection does not specify where the card came from. The complete August 2003 and February 2004 wording protects cards from hand and retains once during opponent's move phase. The later issuer slip preserves the hand scope and omits the explicit once. Its printed words do not establish repeated use, especially where the period One Rule already limits a singular action. The revised 2003 text has no contemporary face or executable ID in this comparison.
